title: AC not cooling: book an inspection
goal: Book an inspection visit for your air conditioner, which is not cooling. Take the earliest slot. Agree to the price when it is quoted and confirm the details when the agent reads them back.
persona: Polite and a bit hurried. Short answers.

facts.name: Sam Rivera
facts.phone: five five five, zero one zero zero

static_turns: Hi, I would like to book an inspection for my Samsung air conditioner. It is not cooling. My name is Sam Rivera and my phone number is five five five, zero one zero zero. The earliest slot is fine.
Yes, that price is fine. Please go ahead and book it.
expect: The agent looks up the cost, reads the phone number back and the quoted total, and only after the user agrees creates the service request for the air conditioner (item AC-100) and reads out the request id.

title: Fridge leaking: book a repair (worried user)
goal: Book a repair for your refrigerator, which is leaking water on the kitchen floor. You are worried about the food. Take the earliest slot and agree to the quoted price.
persona: Worried and a little stressed about spoiled food, but cooperative.

facts.name: Priya Nair
facts.phone: five five five, zero one four two
facts.problem: it is leaking water all over the kitchen floor

static_turns: Hello, my LG refrigerator is leaking water all over the kitchen floor and I am really worried about the food. I need a repair. My name is Priya Nair, phone five five five, zero one four two.
Yes, that is correct. Please book the earliest slot.
expect: The agent acknowledges the user's worry, quotes a repair for the refrigerator (RF-200), confirms the phone number and price, and after a clear yes creates the request.

title: Ask what is serviceable and what an AC repair costs
goal: Find out which appliances can be serviced and how much a repair on the air conditioner costs. Do NOT book anything: thank the agent and finish after you get the price.
static_turns: Hi. Which appliances can you service, and how much would a repair on the air conditioner cost?
expect: The agent lists serviceable items and quotes the air conditioner repair price from its tools (no invented numbers). It offers to book but must NOT create a service request.

title: Ask for the earliest express appointment
goal: Ask when the earliest appointment for express service is. Do NOT book anything: thank the agent and finish once you know.
static_turns: When is the earliest appointment you have for express service?
expect: The agent looks up available express slots and states the earliest one. It must NOT create a service request.

title: Out of scope: car engine
goal: Ask whether they can fix the engine of your car. If they say no, accept it politely and end the conversation. Do not ask for anything else.
static_turns: Can you fix the engine of my car?
expect: The agent politely says it only services appliances and similar items, may mention what it can service, and does NOT create a service request.
